title: Template
description: An extraction template that defines the fields and tables to extract from a specific document type, along with validation rules and confidence thresholds.

id.description: The unique identifier of the template

name.description: The display name of the template

description.description: A description of the document type this template handles

document_type.description: The document type classification this template is designed for

field_definitions.description: The fields to extract from documents

table_definitions.description: The tables to extract from documents

confidence_threshold.description: The minimum confidence score for accepting extracted values without manual review (0.0 to 1.0)

created_at.description: The date and time the template was created

updated_at.description: The date and time the template was last updated
